rows.description: Sweep a wide arc of dawnlight in front of you.
Lunge forward and smash — stuns for 1s.
Dash through enemies, cutting everything in your path.
Spin three times, hitting all around you.
ULTIMATE — call a pillar of light: huge damage and a long stun.
PAGE — Release a crescent of light that pierces everything.
Hurl a bolt that explodes and burns.
Fire three piercing shards that slow.
Five homing missiles seek out foes.
Open a well that drags enemies in and grinds them.
ULTIMATE — call down a meteor. Massive area damage + burn.
PAGE — A storm of falling stars over an area.
Loose a fan of five arrows.
A charged arrow that pierces every enemy in a line.
BOOTS — roll away from your aim; your damage +30% for 1.5 s.
Throw a trap that roots and wounds the first enemies to step in.
ULTIMATE — arrows rain down on an area, slowing everything.
PAGE — Channel a beam of moonlight down a long line.
CHEST — take 60% less damage for 3.5s and shove foes away.
CHEST — restore 120 MP and gain +30% power for 6s.
CHEST — vanish for 3s (+40% speed); your next hit is a guaranteed critical.
HELMET — a roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.
HELMET — freeze all nearby enemies in place for 2s.
HELMET — heal 25% of max HP over 4s.
BOOTS — charge forward, bowling enemies over.
BOOTS — teleport a short distance toward your aim.
BOOTS — +80% move speed for 3s and shake off slows.
BAREFOOT — a quick roll toward your aim. Boots replace it.
Throw a ring of eight piercing knives.
ULTIMATE — mark a spot: a cut now, a killing burst 1.2 s later.
OFF-ACTION — a 0.25 s parry window; a parried hit is negated and the attacker staggered (riposte).
BUCKLER — a 0.35 s parry window; reflects projectiles from T3.
OFF-ACTION — a 0.6-tile sidestep; your next hit is a backstab (+30% crit).
OFF-ACTION — a quick shot that always crits.
OFF-ACTION — a 1.5 s mana shield (-50% damage taken) that pops into a nova.
A short shield dash that staggers what it hits.
ULTIMATE — for 3 s every hit is parried, and each parry restores 10% HP.
Turn to the next page and flick a free cantrip.
Nock the next arrow; your next shot hits 40% harder and pierces once.
ULTIMATE — read every page in the book over 1.5 s.
ULTIMATE — loose every arrow in the quiver over 1.5 s.
Toggle: the world slows to a quarter; you do not. Drains 60 MP/s; hero damage x0.6.
PAGE — instantly heal 35% of max HP.
PAGE — three orbs circle you for 8s, burning anything they touch.
PAGE — lightning leaps between up to 6 enemies.
PAGE — bend the dream: enemies move at 35% speed for 4s.
PAGE — +40% damage for 8s.
PAGE — a star crashes down at your cursor.
Lunge through a line of foes with one long thrust.
ULTIMATE — six needle thrusts down a line, then a finishing lunge that always crits.
An overhead blow that crushes guards: stagger 3.
ULTIMATE — hallow the ground around you: a holy burst, then 5 s of searing light.
One full-circle swing that cleaves everything around you.
ULTIMATE — wind up (poise), then a world-splitting overhead in a wide cone.
Split the ground in a line; the cracks stay for 3 s.
ULTIMATE — a ground slam, then three aftershocks that keep staggering.
A long wheeling sweep that throws foes back on a gust.
ULTIMATE — charge with the point down, then drive it through: pins for 1 s.
A heavy bolt that pierces every enemy in a line and pins them for 0.6 s.
ULTIMATE — brace for 1.2 s, then one siege bolt down a long line (at most 25% of a boss's HP).
A disc that bounces between foes: 4 hits (6 with the Lodestar grip).
ULTIMATE — a great disc carves out and back through everything, slowing it.
ULTIMATE — a rune roots everything inside for 2.5 s, then bursts.
ULTIMATE — a storm wheels around you for 4 s, jolting and shoving foes.
Three raking cuts; the target is Rent (+15% damage taken) for 4 s.

Blocks seeded best-effort from the JS cast; check them against the JS (golden vectors) in wave 2.
a cone block repeats 3x in JS (loop)
JS:
cast: cast(p, a) { for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) delay(k * 0.1, () => { swingWeapon(p, 0.09, 1.6, k % 2 ? 1 : -1); hitCone(p.x, p.y, a, 1.8, 1.6, 55, { knock: 0.08, rent: 4 }); fx({ type: 'slash', x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z, ang: a, arc: 1.8, r: 1.6, col: '#ffb0a0', life: 0.12, w: 2, dir: k % 2 ? 1 : -1 }); sfx('swing'); }); }

rows.description: ULTIMATE — pounce on the target and maul it eight times; Frenzy maxes.
Dance through foes on a gust: each is cut and Marked.
ULTIMATE — a storm of blade-petals wheels with you for 3 s, Marking all it cuts.
HOLD — block 70% of hits from the front (poise); drains stamina.
Drive the shield forward; shots that meet it mid-dash fly back.
ULTIMATE — charge behind the shield, carrying the first foe, and slam it down.
HOLD — stop everything from the front, shots included; you move at half speed.
Heave the wall forward: a gust that hurls a line of foes back.
ULTIMATE — raise a dome for 4 s: enemy shots break on it, and you take 30% less inside.
Turn to the next call and bellow: a guard-breaking roar (stagger 2).
ULTIMATE — 4 s of poise and +30% damage; then Winded (-20% speed) for 3 s.
CALL — heal 12% and +15% damage for 6 s.
HELMET / CALL — every foe nearby turns on you; you take 20% less for 3 s.
CALL — the ground answers the horn: a quake that leaves cracks.
CALL — Brace: poise and 30% less damage for 3 s, then a shove.
ARROW — a barbed arrow that Poisons.
ARROW — a burning arrow that bursts on impact.
ARROW — an icy arrow that Chills.
ARROW — a weighted bola that roots for 1.5 s.
ARROW — a hooked line that drags the target to you.
ARROW — splits in two on its first hit.
ARROW — a powder arrow: a wide blast where it lands.
HELMET / PAGE — call a storm on the aim: 3 s of strikes that Jolt.
HELMET / PAGE — lob a flask: it bursts into a Poison cloud for 4 s.
HELMET / PAGE — a bell of judgement tolls: holy burst, 0.8 s stun.
CHEST — a holy circle follows you for 5 s: foes inside burn, you take 25% less.
BOOTS — leap toward your aim and land in a holy burst.
CHEST — poise and 30% less damage for 3 s, then shove everything away.
HELMET — slam the ground: stagger 2, and cracks that linger 3 s.
BOOTS — rush forward carrying the first foe you meet.
HELMET — a shield worth 25% of max HP for 4 s; it pops into a nova.
CHEST — a frost veil for 5 s: you take 20% less and attackers are Chilled.
BOOTS — skate toward your aim, leaving a frost trail that Chills.
CHEST — for 6 s, every hit you take zaps the attacker and Jolts it.
BOOTS — a lightning line: dash through foes, Jolting each.
HELMET — Mark every foe around the aim twice (+4% damage taken per Mark).
CHEST — thorns for 6 s: melee attackers take nature damage back.
BOOTS — vault back from your aim, leaving a snare where you stood.
CHEST — a long 0.5 s parry window (shares the 1 s parry ICD).
BOOTS — a quick side-step along your movement (cd 3).
CHEST — step into shadow: 2 s unseen, the next hit crits.
HELMET — a smoke burst: foes Chilled and you unseen for 1.5 s.
BOOTS — dash away and leave a decoy where you stood.
CHEST — for 8 s every hit you land Poisons.
BOOTS — slink low: for 2 s you backstab from any angle.
CHEST — an image of you for 6 s: it draws foes and shoots arcane bolts.
BOOTS — phase straight through enemies toward your aim.
